proof_body:
by
  intro α _ A B C
  have h1 := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter (A ∪ B) C
  have h2 := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter A B
  have h3 := Finset.card_union_add_card_inter (A ∩ C) (B ∩ C)
  have e1 : (A ∪ B) ∩ C = (A ∩ C) ∪ (B ∩ C) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_union]
    tauto
  have e2 : (A ∩ C) ∩ (B ∩ C) = A ∩ B ∩ C := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_inter]
    tauto
  rw [e1] at h1
  rw [e2] at h3
  omega
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [DecidableEq α] (A B C : Finset α), (A ∪ B ∪ C).card + ((A ∩ B).card + (A ∩ C).card + (B ∩ C).card) = A.card + B.card + C.card + (A ∩ B ∩ C).card
